status: frozen at the commit that first adds this file, before any GEO outcome has been analysed
what_had_been_seen: GATE 0 only: characteristic keys, level counts, presence counts and expression value ranges (experiments/20260911-geo-gate0). No survival analysis of any GEO cohort has been run.
purpose: Replicate two things in independent public bladder cohorts that carry expression and clinical data but no histology: (1) the combination rule applied to the two modalities these cohorts have (transcriptome and clinical), against its components and the fusion alternatives; (2) the added-value inflation D produced by a grade-based clinical reference. The recipe is re-fitted within each cohort by cross-validation; coefficients fitted on TCGA are not transferred across platforms.

GSE31684.endpoint: disease-specific survival: event = 'last known status' == 'DOD'; time = 'survival.months'
GSE31684.clinical_weak: age ('age at rc'), female indicator ('gender'), grade ('rc grade', case-folded; High/Low)
GSE31684.inclusion: all 93 samples; sensitivity without the pre-cystectomy chemotherapy cases ('prerc_chemo' yes)

GSE32894.endpoint: disease-specific survival: event = 'dod_event_(yes/no)' == 'yes'; time = 'time_to_dod_(months)'; cases with 'dod_excluded_(yes/no)' == 'yes' or a missing event or time are excluded
GSE32894.clinical_weak: age, female, grade ('tumor_grade' G1/G2/G3; Gx coded as reference)
GSE32894.clinical_rule: age, female, stage and grade: both vary in this cohort

GSE48075.endpoint: disease-specific survival: event = 'dss censor' == 'uncensored'; time = 'survival (mo)'; samples without these fields excluded
GSE48075.clinical_stage: age ('age (at specimen collection)'), female ('gender', case-folded), clinical T category parsed from 'cstage' (cTa, cTis, cT1, cT2, cT3, cT4 by leading token)
GSE48075.note: no grade field, so D is not defined here

excluded.GSE48277-GPL14951: neoadjuvant chemotherapy mixed into the cohort and no grade

omics.probe_to_gene: GEO platform annotation (GPL570.annot, GPL6947.annot) 'Gene symbol'; probes mapping to more than one symbol ('///') or none are dropped; probes of one gene are averaged
omics.values: as provided in the series matrix (all three are on log2-type scales; GSE32894 is centred per probe)
omics.pathways: analysis/s5_omics_arm.py pathway_matrix over the 331 SurvPath combine signatures, keeping signatures with at least three genes present

methods.primary: two-arm ModRank: one ridge Cox per arm (transcriptome pathways; clinical stage block), within-fold percentiles, equal-weight rank average. Estimator blca_common.fitapply, grid (1, 8, 64, 512, 4096), inner 3-fold CV.
comparators: concatenated ridge Cox on both blocks, grid extended to 32768
stacked Cox: two weights fitted on inner out-of-fold percentiles (ridge 1.0)
methods.for_D: two-arm ModRank with the weak block in place of the stage block

evaluation.cross_validation: 5 repeats of 5-fold stratified CV, analysis/s18_chimera_two_arm.py strat_folds with np.random.default_rng(0) consumed sequentially; estimator seed = repeat index
evaluation.point_estimate: mean over repeats of the pooled out-of-fold concordance
evaluation.paired: repeat-averaged per-case scores, 6000 case-resampling replicates (rng 20260911), Holm across the comparators within each cohort
evaluation.floor: SD over 24 stratified resplits (rng 3000 + k, estimator seed 0) of C(two-arm ModRank) minus C(clinical stage block); bar = 2 x SD
evaluation.D: [C(ModRank with weak) - C(weak)] - [C(ModRank with stage) - C(stage)], repeat-averaged vectors, 6000 replicates

predictions_written_before_the_run.D_GSE31684: grade is near-constant here (High in about 94%), as in TCGA-BLCA, so D is expected to be positive
predictions_written_before_the_run.D_GSE32894: grade varies here, so the grade reference is not degenerate and D is expected to be smaller than in GSE31684
predictions_written_before_the_run.ModRank: no directional prediction; at 93 and 224 cases the comparisons may not be resolvable

branch_statements_written_before_the_run.rule_holds: Applied to the two modalities an independent cystectomy cohort carries, the combination rule exceeds both its components and both fusion alternatives by more than that cohort's split-reseed floor.
branch_statements_written_before_the_run.rule_does_not_hold: In independent microarray cohorts of 73 to 224 patients, the combination rule on transcriptome and clinical stage does not exceed [named comparator] beyond the floor, and the TCGA result is not replicated on these modalities at this size.
branch_statements_written_before_the_run.D: Reported for both cohorts where it is defined, whatever its sign, beside the prediction above.
